Ultrahomogeneity extends an isomorphism of these spans to a global automorphism, and universality realizes every such finite quotient form. Counting codimension-\(r\) kernels by \({n\brack r}_q\) and symmetric trilinear forms by \(q^{\binom{r+2}{3}}\) yields the formula. A fresh independent computation reproduced the submitted \(q=5\) values \(1,6,656,9785156,95368955582656,2910383120155532786132656\).

originality.rationale: Harman--Snowden Proposition 5.10 is decisive prior coverage for the substantive orbit classification: for linearly independent \(n\)-tuples, their classifying map is exactly the pulled-back tensor structure, is surjective by universality, and its fibers are exactly automorphism orbits by homogeneity. Their positive-characteristic remark states that the same theorem holds when the characteristic exceeds the tensor degree, which covers the submitted \(p>3\) regime. Neretin independently states the finite-field universal cubic space and transitivity on embeddings of each finite cubic space. Passing from an arbitrary tuple to its quotient by the kernel of coordinate relations and then summing the number of kernels is a routine linear-algebra extension of the published classifying-map theorem. Under the audit's implication rule, the final orbit-profile formula is therefore covered.
